name: zam-plugins
local_changes: Package only the LV2 output (zam-plugins-lv2) needed by easyeffects; the full upstream build is preserved, but the CLAP, LADSPA, standalone, VST2, VST3 and meta outputs are not packaged.
Drop the gendesk desktop-file generation and the menu and directory sources used only for standalone integration.
Remove packaged files outside usr/lib/lv2 in package_zam-plugins-lv2(), then install the documentation.
Preserve the signed git source, submodule sources, checksums, bundled signing key and the upstream LV2 output dependencies.
